Fresh block2 profiles used; no result accepted from failed block1.

findings.kind: unsupported multidisc runtime menu in single-disc title
findings.finding: runtime_menu open correctly rejects this single-disc title because its UI is initialized only for a multidisc roster. First menu attempt passed own save/load then rejected open; retained unchanged. Use source-confirmed default F7 save-state host menu, verify actual guestframefreeze and screenshot, Escape close and resumed120vblanks. No binary/source/production timing change.

findings.kind: existing save-state menu does not service debug TCP
findings.finding: F7 entered actual save-state pause; next TCP frame query timed out because savestate_menu_host_pause_loop has no debug_server_poll, unlike rewind_host_pause_loop. Shared base has the same body. No introduced pacing softlock; exact owned process terminated. Use known S7-qualified F8 panel with capture enabled for QA only, frame freeze/status/screenshot, secondF8 close and resumed120frames. Production timings unchanged.
